title: Accessory muscles and Stability workout
author: Enis N.
desc: This small 1 week program is designed to stabilize the body and strengthening the accessory muscles. Good for your posture and helpful for any active person.

ex.note: If you don’t have a bench, just stand straight with light weights in hand and lean slightly forward. I like to do them on one leg to train my balance at the same time. Keep your back straight.
Perform the exercise slowly, hold for three seconds at the top of each rep.
Keep your back straight. Legs at shoulder width apart, knees slightly bend, and then lean your upper body forward. Don’t forget to hinge backward too - moving your butt backwards. Do with bodyweight.
Hold on last rep for 10 seconds, come back down slowly.
Can be done with Dumbbell or just weight plate. Keep your body straight, don’t move anything else in your body besides your arms around your head.
Hold for 2-3 seconds for each rep
Use weights that will make you struggle to reach 1 minute. Don’t go too hard to prevent Injury.
